scope: Actual StarterPlanNote component, isolated language hook and common CSS; synthetic existing-fixture summer/few-big plan. No full route, account, storage or planting mutation.

cases.text:
Ukuze kusetshenziswe indawo ebingahlala ingenalutho ezinyangeni zakho zokuqala, kufakiwe ukuhlwanyela kokuqala okwenzeka kanye: Lettuce (Mas), Carrots (Aga), Cucumber (Dis). Ngakunye kwenzeka kanye. Hlola uhlelo oluphindaphindayo ngaphambi konyaka ozayo: kulezi zinyanga kungase kudingeke okunye ukuhlwanyela okwenzeka kanye uma uhlelo lungashintshi.

Umbhalo ongakabuyekezwa — inothi lohlelo lokuqala ngesiNgisi

To cover ground that would stand empty in your first months, one-time starter sowings are included: Lettuce (Mar), Carrots (Aug), Cucumber (Dec). Each runs once. Check the repeating plan before next year: these months may need another one-time sowing unless the plan changes.

Ho sebedisa mobu o neng o tla dula o se na dijalo dikgweding tsa hao tsa pele, ho kenyelleditswe ho jala ha qalo ho etswang hang feela: Lettuce (Hlb), Carrots (Pha), Cucumber (Tsh). Ho hong le ho hong ho etsahala hang feela. Hlahloba moralo o iphetang pele ho selemo se tlang: dikgwedi tsena di ka hloka ho jala ho hong ha hang feela ntle le haeba moralo o fetoha.

Moralo o eso hlahlojwe — noto ya pele ya moralo ka Senyesemane

To cover ground that would stand empty in your first months, one-time starter sowings are included: Lettuce (Mar), Carrots (Aug), Cucumber (Dec). Each runs once. Check the repeating plan before next year: these months may need another one-time sowing unless the plan changes.

Ku tirhisa misava leyi a yi ta va yi nga ri na swibyariwa etinhwetini ta wena to sungula, ku engeteriwe ku byala ko sungula loku endlekaka kan'we ntsena: Lettuce (Nyku), Carrots (Mhaw), Cucumber (N'we). Ku byala kun'wana ni kun'wana ku endleka kan'we. Kambela pulani leyi vuyelelaka ku nga si fika lembe leri taka: tinhweti leti ti nga ha lava ku byala kun'wana ka kan'we ntsena handle ka loko pulani yi cinca.

Tsalwa ro sungula leri nga si kamberiwaka — notsi ya pulani ya Xinghezi xo sungula

To cover ground that would stand empty in your first months, one-time starter sowings are included: Lettuce (Mar), Carrots (Aug), Cucumber (Dec). Each runs once. Check the repeating plan before next year: these months may need another one-time sowing unless the plan changes.

U shumisa mavu e a ḓo sala a si na zwimela kha miṅwedzi yaṋu ya u thoma, ho dzheniswa u zwala ha u thoma ha khathihi fhedzi: Lettuce (Ṱhaf), Carrots (Ṱhan), Cucumber (Nyen). U zwala huṅwe na huṅwe hu itea luthihi. Sedzulusani pulane i dovhololaho phanḓa ha ṅwaha u ḓaho: miṅwedzi iyi i nga ṱoḓa huṅwe u zwala ha khathihi fhedzi nga nnḓa ha musi pulane i tshi shanduka.

Mvetamveto i sa athu sedzuluswaho — notsi ya pulane ya u thoma nga Luisimane
